prompt:
Generate one fresh complete connected Doctor Roshan hands-washing sprite on a SQUARE canvas, not a long portrait. Actual transparent RGBA outside the character. This is a 2D storybook game cutout and a missing work pose, not a redesign.

Silhouette is the main constraint: the whole sprite fits a nearly square silhouette, width about80–90% of its height. The child is upright in front three-quarter view, with a compact torso. One single moderately short fish tail starts under the purple waistband, curves down in a broad C, then curls BACK UP on the right. Its one modest connected two-lobed fish fin ends to the right of the lower coat, around waist-to-lower-torso height, not hanging far below. Keep the face/head narrower than the flowing hair mass; the head must not dominate the torso. Leave clean transparent margins on all sides and show the entire hair, body and both fin lobes.

Text identity lock: warm peach small child mermaid, friendly large drawn brown eyes, brown soft bangs and caramel-brown wavy hair sweeping to her right; one broad pastel rainbow hair lock with a small cream pearl flower clip. Ivory short-sleeved little doctor's coat with coral collar/cuffs/hem, small rounded heart badge, teal blouse with tiny gold buttons, purple waistband; little ivory/coral medical pouch at the right hip. Gentle lavender-pink-purple/rainbow tail scales, simplified and matte. Two arms attach naturally to the shoulders and meet in front just below the chest, rubbing a small cream/mint soap lather. Look attentively down at the hands. No medical tool held, no bottle or bandage. No legs, feet, extra tails/arms or other characters.

Finish: polished 2D painted storybook cutout with restrained dark plum/brown contours, clear rounded forms, broad calm painted colour bands and soft simple aqua/lavender shadow shapes. Friendly drawn facial features; preserve a child sprite's proportions. Softer illustrated line weight than a heavy vector icon, while keeping crisp contours. No realistic skin or fingers, 3D/glass gloss, hair-strand rendering, glitter/refraction, ambient glow, shadow plate, opaque backdrop, water jets, sink, text, UI or camera effects. One intact fresh sprite only. Square composition with the compact curling-up tail and modest fin is essential.
